name: trivy
title: Trivy
description: Aqua Trivy — multi-target vulnerability and misconfiguration scanner. TRIVY_SCAN_TYPE picks the mode — valid values: fs | image | repo | config | k8s. Pass the corresponding target in TRIVY_TARGET (a directory, image reference, repo URL, IaC dir, or cluster name). TRIVY_SEVERITY is a list of severities to report (e.g. HIGH, CRITICAL). TRIVY_SKIP_DIRS is a list of directories to ignore (e.g. vendor, node_modules, .git). TRIVY_IGNORE_UNFIXED=true hides vulnerabilities without an upstream fix.
